heading: Expressions — cross-pattern constraints
text:
### Expressions — cross-pattern constraints [LNLS.4.3]

Overlays [LEXP.8.2] (where clauses on patterns) and [LTHE.2.4.1]
(cross-pattern slot constraints).

Under `linear_scan: false`, a `where` clause that references bindings from two or
more patterns must satisfy [LNLS.3.3]: its equalities pin the full declared
`key` of a `logical`-lifecycle schema on each side, one per `key` slot.
Additional constraints are allowed.

This constraint becomes the join-key index at compile time.  Because
`logical` retract-and-replace ensures at most one live fact per
identity value, exactly one candidate is found per probe — O(1), not
O(matched).  Remaining constraints are evaluated once against that
single candidate.
